```sql
WITH merrill_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Merrill' AND border_type = 'town'
),
nature_reserves AS (
  SELECT parks.geometry
  FROM parks
  JOIN merrill_region
    ON ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geometry, merrill_region.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE parks.leisure = 'nature reserve'
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_MapAlgebra(
      public.dem_us.rast,
      'slope',
      '32BF',
      'ST_Slope(public.dem_us.rast, 1, "degrees")'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, merrill_region.geometry::geometry)
),
clipped_slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(slope_raster.slope_rast, merrill_region.geometry::geometry) AS clipped_rast
  FROM slope_raster, merrill_region
),
nature_reserves_slope AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(clipped_slope_raster.clipped_rast, nature_reserves.geometry::geometry) AS clipped_rast
  FROM clipped_slope_raster, nature_reserves
)
SELECT
  ROUND(ST_Area(ST_Union(nature_reserves.geometry)) / 1000000, 2) AS total_area_sq_km,
  ROUND(AVG(ST_Value(nature_reserves_slope.clipped_rast, 1, true)), 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM nature_reserves, nature_reserves_slope;
```
